(b) Use the inequality in part (a) to find a lower and upper bound for $\pi$. [5]
(c) Show that $\sum_{r=0}^{n-1}(-1)^r x^{2r}=\frac{1+(-1)^{n-1}x^{2n}}{1+x^2}$. [2]

(a) Show that the tangent to the curve $y=f(x)$ at the point $(1,0)$ is normal to the curve $y=g(x)$ at the point $(1,0)$. [2]
(b) Find $g(x)$. [6]
(c) Use Euler's method with steps of $0.2$ to estimate $f(2)$ to 5 decimal places. [5]
(d) Explain why $y=f(x)$ cannot cross the isocline $x-y^2=0$, for $x>1$. [3]
(e) (i) Sketch the isoclines $x-y^2=-2, 0, 1$.
